note: from the cool-start runs (cold1, cold2): the governor's 800 MHz / 0.62 V point against 600 MHz / 0.52 V at 63 to 68 C; built by tools/ettelem/build_vf.py
points: random fp32, 800 MHz, 67 °C, peak before the governor stepped down

rules.X800: highest board reading from the first 800 MHz sample of a run to 0.3 s after its last one, over every run of X
rules.X600: mean board reading over seconds 2-7 of the runs of X, at 600 MHz held for at least 0.3 s
rules.idle800: mean board reading after a zeros run's last launch while the clock stays at 800 MHz, from 0.3 s after it reached 800
rules.idle600: mean board reading 0.5-2.5 s after each run's last launch (before the next run), at 600 MHz held for at least 0.3 s
rules.zeros600_dyn: the 80 C ablation's fp32 zeros switching watts (analyze_ablation.py dyn): from a cool start zeros stayed at 800 MHz
